agency: Department of Housing and Urban Development
summary: HUD responded that BREAKTHROUGH was directed at new housing production, but noted that a separate Project Rehab program under the Assistant Commissioner for Rehabilitation, Federal Housing Administration, directly addresses the renovation of substandard units.
text: Response: BREAKTHROUGH was specifically directed at the production of new housing. HUD also has in progress a Project Rehab under the direction of the Assistant Commissioner for Rehabilitation, Federal Housing Administration, which directly addresses the renovation problem.
